criteria.description: Score whether the creative intent remains faithful to a 30-second night-rain abandoned-station film and forms a coherent emotional or narrative direction without contradicting the brief.

Score the concrete visual and temporal specificity of both shots, including inspectable subject action, framing or camera behavior, rain/station atmosphere, and a coherent progression across the two shots.
Score how clearly the response explains why its creative choices support the intended mood, rhythm, reveal, or audience effect; labels and generic claims without causal reasoning score poorly.
Score whether the remaining user decisions expose meaningful creative tradeoffs that can change the Draft, rather than cosmetic or generic follow-up questions.
